maddeler.e:
أزدرد (form VIII)
# أَزْدَرِدُ (ʔazdaridu) /ʔaz.da.ri.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
# أُزْدَرَدُ (ʔuzdaradu) /ʔuz.da.ra.du/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
# أَزْدَرِدَ (ʔazdarida) /ʔaz.da.ri.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَرَدَ (izdarada)
# أُزْدَرَدَ (ʔuzdarada) /ʔuz.da.ra
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
